subject: lk-imp
title: LK.IMP.------ MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 148 (SR(TRS)II-4). LK-IMP (linkage implications) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: TH-CONT (thrust continuance) and INFO-DE (information degrees). From TH-CONT: SO-EXP-PRI. From INFO-DE: DIFF, with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From SO-EXP-PRI: IST-F (isolated focus). From DIFF: POL-DY (political dynamics), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
